capabilities.description: 信息解析：从已有完整RSS 2.0/Atom XML提取条目与日期；不联网、不判断新闻影响。优先传sources_fetch返回的完整source_ref；也可传xml_content或包内file_path，三选一。插件读取完整冻结原文，不重新抓取。 长结果返回完整正文/结构资源引用及有界预览。

file_path.description: Relative path to a bundled XML file; cannot access conversation or host files

source_ref.description: Exact immutable data ref returned by sources_fetch; original source is read inside the plugin, without copying a preview or a workspace JSON line.
Exact immutable data ref returned by sources_fetch; original source is read inside the plugin, without copying a preview or a workspace JSON line.

source_provenance.description: Original snapshot final URL, retrieval time, content type and hash; parsing is derived evidence, not a new independent source.

output_truncated.description: True means the complete result is only in result_ref; returned text is a preview.

result_ref.description: Exact immutable derived result artifact; use result_entries with host.resources.read. Original source and provenance are retained inside it.

usage.purpose: 把一份已有feed转成有限条目，供方法/工作流筛选；条目摘要不是文章全文。
usage.inputs: 三选一：{source_ref:<sources_fetch返回的完整ref>}，或{xml_content:<完整文本>}，或{file_path:<包内相对样本路径>}；其余筛选参数按Schema。source_ref由插件按字节分页读取；不要把20000字符预览或data_read工作区路径代替原文。inline输入上限2MiB UTF-8；source_ref原始字节上限2MiB，按原编码解码后上限8MiB UTF-8。
usage.outputs: `format,feed_title,feed_updated,entry_count,entries,source,version`。entry_count是输入全部条数，entries受max_entries限制、没有分页。条目保留title/link/published/id和最多300字符content_snippet，摘要不是文章全文。 source_ref输入自动返回source_ref、source_provenance（原最终URL、获取时间、原始字节hash、内容类型、编码）；source为最终URL。inline/包内输入的source仅为inline/包内文件名，不推断URL或抓取时间。 超过24KiB的解析结果不直接注入上下文：返回output_truncated:true、result_ref、result_entries、result_bytes及有界预览；HTML保留完整text_length，RSS保留entry_count/returned_entries，汇率保留total_currencies/returned_currencies。完整结构在result_entries.structured（rows.json，含一行完整结果和来源），HTML全文另在result_entries.text（text.txt）。用host.resources.read(result_ref,{part:"content",entry:result_entries.text??result_entries.structured,offset:0,length:8192,encoding:"utf8"})按需读取，继续使用返回的nextOffset；Agent工具形状为host_resources_read({ref:result_ref,part:"content",entry:result_entries.structured,offset:0,length:8192,encoding:"utf8"})。HTML正文可改用返回的result_entries.text；RSS/汇率没有text.txt。预览不能当全文，长结果省略text/entries/rates/currencies；小结果保持完整原字段。
prerequisites: Existing Python 3 executable (host pythonPath, otherwise python on Windows / python3 on Linux). Only standard-library modules are used; no API key, pip install or network is required for parsing.
host.resources.read resolves source_ref and host.process.exec runs the bundled parser using owned temporary files.
host.resources.create/publish/remove retain large parsed results as immutable data artifacts; no extra Agent tool is needed.
limitations: 仅支持RSS 2.0/Atom核心字段；有限条目或空摘要不等于没有新闻，也不证明已读文章全文。
不核实来源，不将同一事件转发当独立证据；同一快照可供多个方法复用，不另开报告。
仅解析传入快照；原来源选择、取证权限和收费/登录限制由获取能力处理。XML条目和汇率不代表实时价格，保留原始日期与覆盖范围。
